name: Commerce Promo Bar
description: Provides a fieldable promo_bar entity and a block that renders promotional/notification bars, optionally tied to Commerce promotions.
project_description:
Commerce Promo Bar allows stores to display notifications and promotional information via the bar on top pages or any positions.

 Highlight your product promotions, sales, other offers, general notification, and potential delays. Add a countdown timer to any promo bar.

 Customization:

 
 Multiple promo bars can be stacked 
 One block to display all promo bars 
 Configurable background and text color from UI 
 Configurable countdown from UI 
 WYSIWYG editor to style promo bar message 
 Simple Twig template for advanced modifications 
 Option to use tokens from related Commerce Promotion 
 Fieldable entity, so you can with tokens insert any added field value to the output of promo bar 
 
 

 Available restrictions are per::

 
 Commerce store 
 Customer role 
 Start and end date 
 Path restrictions
